# ZK Nation — Brand Kit

> The official ZKsync Association / ZK Nation brand kit. Everything an agent needs to apply
> the brand to a document, slide deck, website, or component: design tokens, fonts (Inter is
> free; ES Allianz + Avenue Mono are licensed), logos, flags, icons, voice/tone, and a Claude
> Code skill. Primary brand = ZK Nation (governance); secondary = ZKsync protocol.

## Start here (agents)
- [Apply the ZK Nation brand](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/apply-zk-nation-brand.md): step-by-step, machine-readable instructions with all token values.
- [Brand manifest (JSON)](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/brand.json): structured colors, fonts, asset URLs, references.
- [DESIGN.md](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/DESIGN.md): the design system in the design-md format (YAML design tokens + prose; colors, typography, components, do's/don'ts).

## Design tokens
- [brand.css](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/brand/tokens/brand.css): ready-to-link CSS variables + component classes.
- [brand.inline.css](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/brand/tokens/brand.inline.css): flattened, self-contained (tokens + components, no @import) for single-file / offline pages. Also at the short URL https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/brand.css
- [brand-docs.css](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/brand/tokens/brand-docs.css): docs/long-form component layer (sidebar, TOC, breadcrumb, link list, definition list, callout, pager). Link after brand.css.
- [tokens.css](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/brand/tokens/tokens.css): CSS custom properties only.
- [tokens.json](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/brand/tokens/tokens.json): tokens as JSON.
- [tailwind.preset.js](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/brand/tokens/tailwind.preset.js): Tailwind preset.
- [office-theme-colors.xml](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/brand/tokens/office-theme-colors.xml): PowerPoint/Keynote theme colors.

## Assets
- Logos (SVG/PNG), the ZK Nation lockup, ZKsync medallion, flags (blue/orange), ASCII flags, icons, official favicon — under `/brand/logos/`, `/brand/flags/`, `/brand/icons/`.

## Install the skill
- [Claude Code skill (.zip)](https://npc.here.now/zknationbrand/zk-nation-brand-skill.zip)
- Source repo: https://github.com/zksync-association/brandkit

## Key facts
- Primary ink: Brand-900 #04085F (navy). Accent: Brand-700 #070FA0. Surfaces: light. Never full-bleed blue.
- Fonts: Inter (free), ES Allianz Extralight display (licensed), Avenue Mono uppercase labels (licensed).
- Values: Freedom → Progress → Prosperity (the ZK Credo). Spell "ZKsync" and "ZK Nation" exactly.
